coordinates.quote: 200 km² in the Gobi Desert near Xiaodushan, in northern Dunhuang, China
coordinates.note: The collaboration's own progress paper places GRANDProto300 qualitatively ('near Xiaodushan, in northern Dunhuang, China') but gives no numeric coordinates. This point is Dunhuang city itself (from Wikipedia, rank 12), used only as the nearest real, named reference point; the actual 65-antenna array spans ~30 km² somewhere in the Gobi Desert north of the city, not at this exact point. `kind` is 'campus' with `confidence: uncertain`, per A23, precisely because this is a city-level regional pointer, not a surveyed array position.

summary.plain: A stretch of the Gobi Desert north of the city of Dunhuang, China, where a prototype array of radio antennas is testing technology for the giant GRAND project.
summary.technical: Gobi Desert site near Xiaodushan, north of Dunhuang, Gansu, China, hosting the GRANDProto300 prototype radio array; coordinates recorded as the nearest named city (Dunhuang) as a coarse regional pointer, not a surveyed array position.
